name: bc365-al-toolkit
description: Analyze, implement, and review Business Central AL with three skills and Microsoft's local AL MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze, implement, and review Business Central AL
interface.longDescription: Three AL workflow skills, shared coding rules, Microsoft's local AL MCP server, and a Windows compiler fallback. Each skill sets AL_PROJECT_DIR for shell commands and loads its selected project dynamically.
defaultPrompt: Use $al-analyst to analyze this Business Central requirement.
Use $al-developer to implement this AL change and verify compilation.
Use $al-reviewer to review these AL changes and independently verify diagnostics.
